entry.title: Silent Payments coinbase
entry.summary: A new scanning profile is essential for wallets due to the distinct data positioning that signifies ownership, which differs from the locations used in standard silent payments. This difference necessitates a tailored approach to effectively identify and verify wallet owners without compromising security or efficiency. The unique requirements of wallet data management call for specialized protocols that ensure precise and secure data handling, distinguishing it significantly from traditional silent payment systems where data locations are more standardized and predictable.
